Removed duplicate metrics and acronym variations. Kept only the base metric names without parentheses/abbreviations for consistency.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM agent behaviors in social deduction games using automatic metrics derived from gameplay outcomes. The NLG aspect involves dialogue generation for strategic interactions in Avalon gameplay. The extraction was generally good but contained some duplicates and needed normalization of model naming conventions.
